{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:", sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of status
print("Status distribution:\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of channel and customer_segment
print("Channel distribution:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the revenue column for formatting issues
print("Revenue sample (first 5):")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Customer age -1 count:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
